resolution_notes: status: auditor correct — WorldTimeAPI is officially sunset; project announced shutdown and service is no longer operational (https://worldtimeapi.org/ and https://github.com/worldtimeapi/worldtimeapi). base_url: auditor correct — the former API root is no longer a functioning service endpoint for active directory use; do not substitute timeapi.world (different product). pricing: auditor correct — free-tier/paid claims no longer apply to a discontinued service. example.request: auditor correct — example targets the discontinued host and should not be presented as a working request. Evidence: official site/GitHub shutdown notices and failed live reachability of https://worldtimeapi.org/api.
